verdict.rationale: OpenCode's own site documents signing in with GitHub to use a Copilot account and with OpenAI to use a ChatGPT Plus/Pro account. A community user confirms running OpenCode on a Codex $200/mo subscription, and another notes Anthropic shut down the side-loaded subscription auth, so supported subscriptions are limited to certain vendors. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the login/auth flow (evidence is homepage feature lines only), support for other vendors' subscriptions such as Anthropic's.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Log in with GitHub to use your Copilot account
Log in with OpenAI to use your ChatGPT Plus or Pro account
Last month I switched to just using OpenCode with a Codex $200/mo subscription, and that's been great.
